whenToUse: Actions attached to a button: row ⋯ menu, New ▾, user menu, column visibility.
Checkbox and radio items for view options.
avoidWhen: Choosing a form value — use Select or Combobox.
A single action — use a Button.
a11y: The trigger needs a label (Actions for Ada Lovelace); menu items follow the menu pattern.
Dangerous items use the danger tone and confirm.
